breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the contradictory boundary conditions (Dirichlet and Periodic). It removed the incorrect periodic condition and retained only the Dirichlet condition, which aligns perfectly with the ground truth. The generated specification states to "Apply Dirichlet boundary conditions u(x,y)=cos(pi*x)*cos(pi*y) on all four edges" and makes no mention of the erroneous periodic condition.
